_readme: Per-repo configuration for the shared gate tests installed from commons (@thiengthb/test-*). Keeping it here means the test files stay byte-identical to the registry copies — an exception is data, never an edit to the check.

no-emoji._allow_note: Empty by design. Every remaining site is argued for IN CODE with an inline `rulebook-allow[-file]: emoji-as-icon — <reason>` directive, the same vocabulary the rulebook plugin enforces at generation time — one reason, written once, satisfies both. The in-app UI copy that had emoji standing in for icons was cleaned on 2026-07-29 (lucide icons or plain words); lib/notify/** kept its emoji as deliberate Discord voice. This key stays as the escape hatch for a future burn-down list at install time.
